commit.message: Run larger scale SPARQL BSBM benchmark

Update README.md to mention Docker

People no familiar with Rust may prefer Docker to try out oxygraph, so existence of Docker image should be mentioned.

Closes #1165.

Fixes parsing of decimal at the end of the file

Issue #1164
Removes dead code and makes Clippy happy

Bump openssl in the cargo group across 1 directory

Bumps the cargo group with 1 update in the / directory: [openssl](https://github.com/sfackler/rust-openssl).


Updates `openssl` from 0.10.68 to 0.10.70
- [Release notes](https://github.com/sfackler/rust-openssl/releases)
- [Commits](https://github.com/sfackler/rust-openssl/compare/openssl-v0.10.68...openssl-v0.10.70)
